description: This file contains class and function declarations for IR analysis in Torch's tensor expression JIT, including visitors for detecting randomness, finding nodes, variables, buffers, and analyzing buffer live ranges and modifications.

classes.name: HasRand
classes.description: Visitor class to detect presence of random number generation in IR statements.

classes.name: NodeFinder
classes.description: Template class to find nodes of a specific operation type within IR statements or expressions.

classes.name: VarFinder
classes.description: Visitor class to find all variable pointers used within IR statements or expressions.

classes.name: BufFinder
classes.description: Visitor class to find all buffer pointers used within IR statements or expressions.

classes.name: WritesToBuf
classes.description: Visitor class to find all write operations to a specific buffer.

classes.name: StmtsReadingBuf
classes.description: Visitor class to find all statements that read from a specific buffer.

classes.name: ExternalAllocBufFinder
classes.description: Visitor class to find buffers involved in external calls with allocation.

classes.name: ModifiesVarChecker
classes.description: Visitor class to check if a variable is modified within a statement.

classes.name: BufLiveRange
classes.description: Analyzes the live range of a buffer within a block of statements.

classes.name: CreateBufferMap
classes.description: Analyzes IR to create a mapping of multi-dimensional buffers to their flat counterparts for block backend processing.

methods.name: has_rand
methods.description: Returns true if the statement contains a random number generation intrinsic.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds nodes of a specific operation type within IR statements or expressions.

methods.name: vars
methods.description: Returns the set of variables found.

methods.name: bufs
methods.description: Returns the set of buffers found.

methods.name: writes
methods.description: Returns the list of write statements to the target buffer.

methods.name: reads
methods.description: Returns the list of statements reading from the target buffer.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a variable is modified within a statement.

methods.name: liveRange
methods.description: Calculates the live range (start and end indices) of a buffer within a block of statements.

methods.name: getBufferMap
methods.description: Returns the map of input names to tensor buffers.
